# ---- H2: macro f1 with a known confusion matrix ----
# model: prediction = 0 if quantized length == 0 else 1 (dense tie -> 0)
doc = base(None, None,
           conns=[conn("a", 0, 0, "dev"), conn("b", 0, 0, "dev"),
                  conn("c", 0, 1, "dev"), conn("d", 0, 1, "dev")],
           pkts=[pkt(0, "a", 1), pkt(1, "a", 1), pkt(2, "b", 0), pkt(3, "b", 0),
                 pkt(4, "c", 1), pkt(5, "c", 1), pkt(6, "d", 0), pkt(7, "d", 0)])
o = json.loads(run(doc).stdout)
check("H2 dev report", o["reports"]["dev"],
      {"connections": 4, "confusion": [[1, 1], [1, 1]], "macro_f1": [1, 2]})
check("H2 eval report", o["reports"]["eval"],
      {"connections": 0, "confusion": [[0, 0], [0, 0]], "macro_f1": [0, 1]})

check("H2 votes", [c["votes"] for c in o["connections"]], [[1, 1], [2, 0], [1, 1], [2, 0]])
